item.description: Deepen your proficiency in diagnosing and treating seborrheic dermatitis with recent findings about the science behind this disease... The post Seborrheic Dermatitis: New Pathophysiology Evidence and Therapeutic Implications appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Functional Neurologic Disorder: Patient Voices on Care Gaps
item.description: Functional neurologic disorder is a positive-sign diagnosis and patient perspectives show why early empathic communication matters. The post Functional Neurologic Disorder: Patient Voices on Care Gaps appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Plasma p-tau217 Cutoffs Improve Amyloid Detection Accuracy
item.description: Biologically informed plasma p-tau217 cutoffs improve amyloid beta detection accuracy and cost efficiency, outperforming standard thresholds and highlighting subgroup specific strategies for clinical implementation. The post Plasma p-tau217 Cutoffs Improve Amyloid Detection Accuracy appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Microbiome Shifts After Rectal Cancer Surgery
item.description: Rectal cancer surgery triggers perioperative microbiome shifts, with lower diversity plus increased Enterococcus and Streptococcus. The post Microbiome Shifts After Rectal Cancer Surgery appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Retinal Imaging Enables Contactless Blood Pressure Biometry
item.description: Researchers demonstrate that AI retinal imaging can estimate blood pressure non-invasively, potentially improving long-term hypertension assessment. The post AI Retinal Imaging Enables Contactless Blood Pressure Biometry appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Automated Screening Boosts Urinary Incontinence Diagnosis in Women
item.description: Automated urinary incontinence screening in primary care increased diagnoses and pelvic floor therapy referrals among more than 72,000 women in a US quality-improvement study. The post Automated Screening Boosts Urinary Incontinence Diagnosis in Women appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Intermittent Fasting Reduces Crohn’s Disease Activity by 40%
item.description: A clinical trial suggests intermittent fasting may reduce Crohn’s disease activity and improve symptoms, without calorie restriction. The post Intermittent Fasting Reduces Crohn’s Disease Activity by 40% appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Maternal Diabetes Associated with Epilepsy in Offspring
item.description: Maternal diabetes is associated with an increased epilepsy risk in offspring, a 2026 cohort study has found. The post Maternal Diabetes Associated with Epilepsy in Offspring appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Rising Global Childhood CKD Highlights Health Inequality Gaps
item.description: A global analysis of childhood CKD reveals rising adolescent incidence, widening health inequalities, and links between kidney replacement therapy access and reduced disease burden. The post Rising Global Childhood CKD Highlights Health Inequality Gaps appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ABPI launch report to bridge UK’s drug discovery gap
item.description: The pharmaceutical industry faces a significant technical bottleneck: only 10% of R&D ends in an approved medicine. The post ABPI launch report to bridge UK’s drug discovery gap appeared first on European Medical Journal.
